description:
Title: iOS Developer 
 Location: Dallas or Atlanta Preferred 
 Duration: 2 years 
 Need GC and USC 
 Top Three Skills: 
 1. 5+ years of Objective C development (creating native apps for enterprise customers- working knowledge with Swift) 
 2. Experience using Xcode to create enterprise mobile apps
 3. 5+ years integrating mobile functionality with API's
 4. Agile (experience creating mobile apps within 2 week iterations) 
 Job Description: 
 This person will be doing 100% new development on a next-gen, industry leading enterprise mobile application.
 The MobileKey application provides an open-source, secure single-sign on capability to all other AT&T products and services.
 On a daily basis, they will be given use cases from the Security Architecture Team and asked to perform entirely new development in Objective C. This person will be developing new secure, single-sign on capabilities/portal for the rest of the enterprise. 
 This will be a true agile environment with daily stand-ups and two week iterations. 
 This is an agile, continuous integration environment. It will give this person experience working with Jenkins/Automation. 
 Current Technology Stack:
 Swift Objective C, C, jqueryMobile, webservices, REST, API's, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Xcode


 If you are interested please share your resume to Preethib @usmsystems(DOT)com or you can call me directly on 703 468 0398.
